description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.9 second step. With `pkix_lint::check_shape` available (PKIX-9vnx.9.1), expose one-liner aliases in pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf so consumers don't reach for the lint engine directly for the common cases.

## What

### In pkix-profiles

```rust
pub fn check_basic_tls_shape(cert: &Certificate, now_unix: u64) -> Result<(), Vec<pkix_lint::Finding>>;
pub fn check_basic_smime_shape(cert: &Certificate, now_unix: u64) -> Result<(), Vec<pkix_lint::Finding>>;
```

Each is a one-liner calling `pkix_lint::check_shape(cert, SubjectKind::Leaf, now_unix, &<Profile>)` for the appropriate Profile.

### In pkix-profiles-cabf

```rust
pub fn check_cabf_tls_br_shape(cert: &Certificate, now_unix: u64) -> Result<(), Vec<pkix_lint::Finding>>;
pub fn check_cabf_smime_br_shape(cert: &Certificate, now_unix: u64) -> Result<(), Vec<pkix_lint::Finding>>;
pub fn check_cabf_code_signing_shape(cert: &Certificate, now_unix: u64) -> Result<(), Vec<pkix_lint::Finding>>;
```

### Preconditions

Before the aliases can exist, the Profile types in each crate must implement `pkix_lint::LintProfile` (which requires `fn lints(&self) -> Vec<Box<dyn Lint>>`). Today they implement `pkix_path::Profile` only.

- `BasicTlsProfile` and `BasicSmimeProfile` (pkix-profiles): need `impl LintProfile` with appropriate Lint sets. The Lint sets reference RFC-conformance lints; new lints may need to land (RFC 6125 SAN parts, server-auth EKU as RFC-conformance) — itemise during work.
- `WebPkiProfile`, `SmimeProfile`, `CodeSigningProfile` (pkix-profiles-cabf): need `impl LintProfile` referencing `pkix-lint-cabf::cabf_tls_br` lints (assumes PKIX-amgn.5 has landed the CABF lints in pkix-lint-cabf).

### Dependency-graph design decision

pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf today do **not** depend on pkix-lint. To define convenience aliases that return `Vec<Finding>` (a pkix-lint type) and call into pkix-lint, both crates would need pkix-lint as a dep. That changes the workspace dep graph.

Options:

- **(i) Add pkix-lint as a workspace dep of pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf.** Direct, clear. Downstream crates see the chain explicitly. ✓ recommended.
- **(ii) Define a separate crate (`pkix-shape-checks` or similar) that depends on pkix-profiles + pkix-profiles-cabf + pkix-lint, holding only the convenience aliases.** Cleaner per-crate dep boundaries but adds a new crate for a small piece of glue. ✗ rejected as over-engineering.
- **(iii) Put the aliases in pkix-lint directly, accepting a `Profile` type parameter.** Avoids the new deps but doesn't match the bead's stated 'aliases live in pkix-profiles / pkix-profiles-cabf'. ✗ rejected as scope drift.

This decision is requested as human approval; if uncertain, label `human` and stop.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `BasicTlsProfile`, `BasicSmimeProfile` in pkix-profiles implement `LintProfile`.
- [ ] `WebPkiProfile`, `SmimeProfile`, `CodeSigningProfile` in pkix-profiles-cabf implement `LintProfile`.
- [ ] Five convenience aliases ship per the signatures above.
- [ ] Each alias has a passing test against a known-good cert (`Ok`) and an Error test against a deliberately bad cert (`Err` with the expected finding present).
- [ ] Rustdoc on each alias cross-references the core `pkix_lint::check_shape`.

## Out of scope

- New RFC-conformance Lint impls beyond what already exists. If the Lint set for `BasicTlsProfile::lints()` would currently be empty (no RFC 6125 SAN lints in pkix-lint yet), file a sub-bead for the missing Lints rather than implementing them here.

## Depends on

- PKIX-9vnx.9.1 (core `check_shape`).
- PKIX-amgn.5 (CABF lints in pkix-lint-cabf — for the cabf aliases).

## Design question (human approval)

Confirm option (i) — adding pkix-lint as a workspace dep of pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf.
notes:
[2026-05-13 bd-spin partial-execution escalation] Attempted to add pkix-lint + pkix-lint-cabf as direct workspace deps of pkix-profiles + pkix-profiles-cabf per the recorded 2026-05-11 dep-graph decision. cargo refused with a dependency cycle:

  pkix-profiles-cabf
  → pkix-lint-cabf (would-be new dep, my edit)
  → pkix-profiles-cabf (existing — pkix-lint-cabf/src/cabf_tls_br.rs uses pkix_profiles_cabf::WebPkiProfile)

ROOT CAUSE: pkix-lint-cabf::cabf_tls_br::CabfTlsBrProfile is a  type that lives in the -lint crate but delegates to pkix_profiles_cabf::WebPkiProfile. This conflates Profile (validation policy, -profiles crates) with Lint (advisory checks, -lint crates). With the new dep added in the other direction (pkix-profiles-cabf::WebPkiProfile::lints() referencing pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br lints), the cycle becomes unavoidable.

ROOT CAUSE confirmed by pkix-lint-cabf/Cargo.toml line 16-18: 'pkix-profiles-cabf: WebPkiProfile (delegated to by CabfTlsBrProfile) and the SC-081 phased validity cap helper.' This dependency was already there before this bead's work — it just was not the active edge until now.

THREE RESOLUTIONS:

(A) **Move CabfTlsBrProfile out of pkix-lint-cabf** into pkix-profiles-cabf where it architecturally belongs (it's a Profile, not a Lint). Once moved, pkix-lint-cabf no longer needs pkix-profiles-cabf as a dep, and pkix-profiles-cabf can freely depend on pkix-lint-cabf. Substantive but principled refactor. Affects: 'cabf_tls_br' module name shape, downstream callers using pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br::CabfTlsBrProfile (audit: pkix_chain-simple? pkix-difftest? unclear without scan).

(B) **Drop the cabf-side lints from WebPkiProfile::lints()** — have CABF Profile lint sets contain only RFC-conformance lints from pkix-lint (BcCaFlagLint, EkuServerAuthLint, etc.). check_web_pki_shape becomes a weaker check; doesn't enforce CA/B Forum SHA-1 prohibition / 39-month validity cap / 2048-bit RSA floor / etc. Breaks the bead's stated intent ('WebPkiProfile::lints() referencing pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br lints'). Backward-compatible.

(C) **Invert the pkix-lint-cabf → pkix-profiles-cabf edge** via trait object / type parameter so CabfTlsBrProfile doesn't directly name WebPkiProfile. Substantial refactor of cabf_tls_br module's internals.

Mark's 2026-05-11 dep-graph decision was 'option (i): add pkix-lint as workspace dep of pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf' — that specific edge IS the one that creates the cycle. The decision was correct in spirit but did not anticipate the existing reverse edge. Re-decision needed:

- A is the cleanest architectural fix (Profile in -profiles, Lint in -lint).
- B is the smallest change but ships a weaker shape-check.
- C is the most defensive but adds indirection that hides where the dep lives.

Reverted the cargo.toml edits (verified workspace cargo check passes). NOT claiming this bead's implementation work until the cycle resolution is settled. Filing as a question; bd-spin will surface it as human_needed.
title: Convenience aliases: check_basic_tls_shape / check_basic_smime_shape / check_web_pki_shape / check_smime_shape / check_code_signing_shape
